purpose: A vendor-neutral route from public agent or model infrastructure to independently reproducible governance measurements and signed evidence records.
first_deliverable: One privacy-preserving Route Receipt plus a declared-versus-observed gap report. No confidential request or response content is required.

start_without_permission.rule: Submit only public, non-sensitive material. A public measurement request does not create a partnership.

x402_commission.deliverable: A signed commission receipt and any already-admitted signed cards on file for the named subject.
x402_commission.limitation: Payment records a commission. It does not guarantee that a target will be measurable, admitted, or assigned any outcome.

independence: A public target can be independently indexed or measured without becoming a partner.
Design-partner, funding, access-credit and infrastructure relationships must be disclosed.
Measured entities receive the same correction path and cannot buy a result or veto publication.
disclaimer: Open invitation only. No listed or measured organization is a partner, customer, sponsor or endorser unless a separate public relationship record says so.
